title: Effects of Auditing Regulation on Charity Performance
description: Estimate the effects of audit-requirement notches on Australian charities using dynamic bunching estimation and difference-in-differences designs

title: Impacts of Monetary Policy on the Economic Activity of Oregon
description: Estimates how the federal funds rate affects Oregon’s real GDP growth, unemployment, and coincident economic activity using structural VARs identified by Cholesky decomposition, with impulse response analysis

title: Corruption Risks in Ethiopia’s Productive Safety Net Programme
description: Rigorously analyzes corruption risks in Ethiopia’s PSNP; examines how a leader may establish an information flow, prioritize among risks using ethical frameworks and practical considerations, and take effective action using significant results from the corruption literature

title: How Much Do Teleworkers Work?
description: Examines the relationships between teleworking and number of hours worked using CPS data.
